task: Resume the rejected BioFabric STEP-02 interchange lane in place. The current custody commit implements the nine I/O formats, but a fresh independent source review found five concrete defects. Own only crates/core/src/io/xml.rs and crates/core/src/io/gw.rs, including their existing private in-module tests. Do not edit public types, manifests, lockfiles, fixtures, external tests, other source paths, Git metadata, or workflow artifacts. Preserve all previously accepted behavior: standard BIF annot tags and optional colors, plugin raw-payload fidelity, empty drain-zone containers, regular/shadow column handling, metadata/scores already covered, XML entity/duplicate-attribute validation, layout-vs-network write validation, GW directedness/duplicate-label checks, and all non-XML/GW formats. Make the smallest complete evidence-backed repairs: (1) require modeled XML leaf elements sessionState, sessionMetadata, layoutState, and displayOptions to have a complete legal form; reject malformed/unclosed versions rather than silently accepting them; (2) make XML read/write preserve every public DisplayOptions field and all NetworkLayout state currently lost by the writer/reader: link_group_order, layout_mode_text, link_group_annots, and cluster_assignments. Use a backward-compatible, escaped representation that round-trips deterministically and does not corrupt raw plugInDataSets payloads; (3) enforce legal placement/nesting for modeled XML elements and containers, while continuing to treat plugInDataSets payload as opaque raw data; (4) reject XML annotations with end < start before installing them; (5) fully consume each documented GW node and edge record, rejecting malformed trailing fields or labels instead of extracting a label from anywhere in the line. Preserve valid writer output and valid normal GW/BIF input. Add focused private regressions for all five findings, including a full populated Session round trip across every affected public field, malformed singleton XML, illegal modeled nesting, inverted annotations, and a GW edge with internal trailing junk. Run focused non-Docker source checks available to the worker; do not invoke Docker, a verifier, or Git. Write a truthful RESULT.json naming changed paths, checks, and uncertainty. ROOT will run the authoritative pinned bridge and another independent review before acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Only xml.rs and gw.rs plus their existing in-module tests change during this resume; protected paths and public APIs remain untouched.
Malformed modeled XML and malformed/internal-trailing GW records return ParseError rather than producing a lossy or partial Session/Network.
A populated Session preserves every DisplayOptions field and the named NetworkLayout state through XML write/read, without changing plugin raw payload behavior.
Modeled XML placement and annotation ranges are validated, while valid BIF with empty containers and standard annotations remains accepted.
RESULT.json truthfully records exact paths, checks, and limitations.
deliverables: Scoped XML/GW correctness repairs with in-module regression coverage.
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: The independent validation review found five material wire-format correctness and losslessness defects. This resume is deliberately restricted to their two affected implementation files before another bridge check and fresh review.
